business_problem: Unilever wanted to transform legal service delivery so its global legal team could operate in a more efficient, simplified, digitally enabled way and improve operational effectiveness while supporting the business.
solution_summary: Unilever's legal transformation centers on three global Legal Powerhouses in Bangalore, Mexico City, and Barcelona, where lawyers are equipped with generative AI tools as part of a digitally enabled operating model. The implementation is described at the workflow layer rather than as a named vendor stack: legal staff use the tools to run research, draft letters, and review contracts, then subject every AI-generated output to lawyer review and critical judgement before it is used. In practice, legal questions, contract text, and drafting requests are provided by Unilever's legal teams; the AI tools return research summaries or draft content that supports service delivery to the wider business. Unilever also built governance around the deployment by creating rules for Legal and the broader company so AI use remains ethical, responsible, and aligned to operational effectiveness goals.

solution_components.name: generative AI tools
solution_components.role: Used by Unilever lawyers to conduct research, draft letters, and review contracts, with all outputs reviewed by lawyers before use.

data_flow: Lawyers in Unilever's global Legal Powerhouses provide research requests, drafting prompts, and contract materials to generative AI tools; the tools return draft content or research outputs, which lawyers then review with critical judgement before using them to support legal service delivery to the wider business.
business_outcome: The deployment helps Unilever increase efficiency, streamline ways of working, reduce time spent on routine legal tasks, and free lawyers to focus more on strategic legal work.
architecture_clues: Three global Legal Powerhouses support the model: Bangalore, Mexico City, and Barcelona.
Generative AI is used for legal research, letter drafting, and contract review.
Human review is required for everything generated by the AI tools.
